The food seems to be roughly a 15 cm area with a moderate pile. I'd estimate about 250 g in total: roughly 150 g of white chunks, 60 g of salsa, and 40 g of the orange pieces.

For energy, if the white chunks are fresh cheese at about 2.5 kcal/g, that comes to about 375 kcal. If they are potatoes or egg whites, it would be much lower.
